summary.en: Tech leads with AI rally as markets recover from overnight volatility. Energy prices climb amid Middle East geopolitical tensions. US 10Y yields rise slightly on inflation re-pricing concerns.
summary.zh: 科技股领涨，AI 板块反弹。能源价格攀升，中东地缘政治紧张局势加剧。美债收益率小幅上升，市场对通胀预期重新定价。

title.en: US 10Y Treasury Yield Edges Higher at 4.248% on Inflation Repricing
title.zh: 10 年期美债收益率小幅攀升至 4.248%，市场重新定价通胀预期

impact.en: Rising yields pressure rate-sensitive sectors but signal bond market digesting new CPI data. Could limit rally breadth if yield curve steepens further.
impact.zh: 收益率上升施压利率敏感板块，但反映市场消化新 CPI 数据。若收益率曲线进一步陡峭，可能限制反弹广度。

macroRisk.en: Mild - yields moving within normal range, inflation expectations remain anchored
macroRisk.zh: 温和 - 收益率处于正常范围，通胀预期保持锚定

title.en: Oil Surge to $92.42 as Middle East Tensions Persist
title.zh: 油价飙升至 92.42 美元，中东紧张局势持续

impact.en: Strait of Hormuz reopening efforts cautious. Iran war spurs energy security concerns. EV/transportation stocks face margin pressure from higher costs.
impact.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡重新开放努力谨慎。伊朗战争引发能源安全担忧。电动车/运输股面临成本上涨的利润率压力。

macroRisk.en: Moderate - oil at $92 could pressure inflation, but supply remains adequate. Geopolitical premium priced in.
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 油价在 92 美元可能对通胀施压，但供应充足。地缘政治溢价已定价。

title.en: AI Sector Rebound: NVIDIA, Microsoft Lead Tech Gains
title.zh: AI 板块反弹：英伟达、微软领涨科技股

impact.en: Strong demand for AI chips continues. Data center capex spending remains robust. Cloud giants benefit from enterprise AI adoption.
impact.zh: AI 芯片需求强劲。数据中心资本支出保持稳健。云巨头受益于企业 AI 采用。

macroRisk.zh: 低 - 基本面支撑估值

title.en: Gold Climbs to $4,830 as Safe-Haven Flows Continue
title.zh: 黄金攀升至 4,830 美元，避险资金持续流入

impact.en: Safe-haven demand amid Middle East uncertainty. Gold miners and streaming stocks benefit from higher prices. Hedging portfolio against geopolitical volatility.
impact.zh: 中东不确定性的避险需求。金矿商和勘探股受益于价格上涨。对冲地缘政治波动。

macroRisk.zh: 低 - 非相关资产提供分散化

title.en: European Markets Rally, Asian Markets Mixed on Geopolitics
title.zh: 欧洲市场大涨，亚洲市场因地缘政治表现分化

impact.en: FTSE +0.73%, STOXX +1.56% show risk appetite recovering. Nikkei -1.75% reflects ongoing Japan-specific concerns and USD strength. Cross-asset linkages intact.
impact.zh: 富时指数 +0.73%，斯托克指数 +1.56% 显示风险偏好恢复。日经 -1.75% 反映日本特定担忧和美元走强。跨资产关联保持。

macroRisk.zh: 低 - 分化快速正常化

ai.en: Strong rebound driven by data center demand. NVIDIA, Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet all posting gains. Cloud capex cycles intact.
ai.zh: 数据中心需求强劲反弹。英伟达、微软、Meta、Alphabet 均上涨。云支出周期保持完整。

semiconductor.en: Positive sentiment from AI chip demand. AMD, Intel benefit from recovery. Trading at reasonable valuations relative to guidance.
semiconductor.zh: AI 芯片需求的积极情绪。AMD、英特尔受益于复苏。相对于指引，估值合理。

bigTech.en: Magnificent 7 lead gains. NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META all up. AI monetization driving earnings visibility.
bigTech.zh: 优秀七巨头领涨。NVDA、MSFT、GOOGL、AMZN、META 均上涨。AI 变现推动盈利能见度。

energy.en: Brent at $92.42 (+2.26%). Oil majors (BP, Shell, TotalEnergies) saw Q1 profits of $2.5B+. Geopolitical premium supports prices.
energy.zh: 布伦特原油 92.42 美元（+2.26%）。石油巨头（BP、壳牌、道达尔）第一季度利润达 25 亿美元以上。地缘政治溢价支撑价格。

ev.en: Mixed - Tesla faces margin pressure from higher oil costs. Supply chain recovering but Chinese EV competition intensifies.
ev.zh: 分化 - 特斯拉面临更高的油价成本带来的利润率压力。供应链恢复，但中国电动车竞争加剧。

market.en: SPX +1.20%, NASDAQ +1.52%, Dow +1.79% show broad-based recovery. Rotation from defensive to cyclical sectors evident.
market.zh: 标普 +1.20%，纳指 +1.52%，道指 +1.79% 显示全面复苏。防御性板块向周期性板块的轮动明显。

preciousMetals.en: Gold +0.93% at $4,829. Silver also climbing. Safe-haven flows amid Middle East tensions. miners benefit from higher prices.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金 +0.93% 至 4,829 美元。白银也攀升。中东紧张的避险资金流入。矿商受益于高价格。

oil.en: Brent $92.42 (+2.26%). WTI likely similar. Hormuz reopening cautious. Iran war impacts supply security. Airlines/transporters watch costs.
oil.zh: 布伦特 92.42 美元（+2.26%）。WTI 可能类似。霍尔木兹重新开放谨慎。伊朗战争影响供应安全。航空公司/运输商关注成本。

futures.en: S&P / Nasdaq / Dow futures up, suggesting Asian close strength or Europe carryover. Monitor for opening gaps.
futures.zh: 标普/纳指/道指期货上涨，表明亚洲收盘强势或欧洲延续。关注开盘缺口。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y at 4.248% (+4bps). Watch for further yield moves as Fed speakers emerge. Rate-sensitive sectors need monitoring.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期在 4.248%（+4bp）。随着美联储演讲者出现，关注进一步收益率变动。需监控利率敏感板块。

dxy.en: USD strength from European/Asian declines. EUR/USD down. DXY watch for any weakness that could fuel risk rally.
dxy.zh: 美元因欧洲/亚洲下跌走强。欧元/美元下跌。关注 DXY 任何疲软可能推动风险反弹。

oil.en: Brent futures at $92.42 (+2.26%). Geopolitical support persists. Supply adequate but geopolitical premium priced.
oil.zh: 布伦特期货 92.42 美元（+2.26%）。地缘政治支持持续。供应充足但地缘政治溢价已定价。

keyRisk.en: Middle East escalation + yield curve steepening could trigger volatility. Monitor Iran Strait dynamics and inflation data.
keyRisk.zh: 中东升级 + 收益率曲线陡峭化可能触发波动。监控伊朗海峡动态和通胀数据。

note.en: Market recovering well from overnight volatility. Tech/energy rally offsets safe-haven flows. Monitor Middle East and yields for potential shifts.
note.zh: 市场从隔夜波动中恢复良好。科技/能源反弹抵消避险资金流入。监控中东和收益率以观察潜在转变。
